title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock
hook: Don't use two loops for this one — there's an O(n) trick 👀
problem: Pick one day to buy and a later day to sell. Return the max profit.
idea: Keep the cheapest price so far. Profit = today − cheapest.

steps.say: Day 0: price 7 is our cheapest so far

tip: Update the minimum before computing profit
